summary: A West London conveyancing firm appears to lose quotes because the page has no quote tool and shows signs of age.

findings.problem: The page promises Get a quote today but appears to offer no quote form, only a link to another contact page.
findings.cost: Visitors who want a quick price must leave the page.
findings.fix: An on page quote form or calculator.

findings.problem: The footer appears to show 2016, and a Like on Facebook share button appears to point to a third party demo page.
findings.cost: Old dates and wrong links make the firm look inactive.
findings.fix: A current date and correct social links.

findings.problem: The page appears to say affordable fixed fee while also saying fees depend on the transaction, and no example fees appear.
findings.cost: Mixed messages and no prices push clients to compare elsewhere.

findings.problem: The location messaging appears to switch between Central, North and West London, and no testimonials or case studies appear.
findings.cost: Unclear coverage and no proof weaken trust.
findings.fix: One clear coverage area and real client reviews.
